SW431-DRAIN-DIV-SIGNED.rationale: B1.11 non-SWDIVDINF negative transfer uses the same conductivity/transmissivity spatial partition as positive transfer. Existing positive API remains fail-closed; serialized production composition uses the signed successor.

SW431-DRAIN-DIV-MULTI.rationale: B1.11 active-level ordering, cumulative FlowDrDisch, transmissivity-derived interacting discharge-layer bottoms and signed per-level nodal closure are implemented in the ordinary DIVDRA owner and exposed through explicit multilevel serialized requests.

SW431-DRAIN-INF-SPLIT.dependency: QUALIFIED SW431-DRAIN-DIV-SIGNED plus shared extraction/reuse of B19 separate-infiltration partition algebra
SW431-DRAIN-INF-SPLIT.design_boundary: Do not duplicate mod_frost_divdra_drainage_effect partition physics. Ordinary successor needs a shared source-faithful partition primitive with exact B19 preservation.

SW431-DRAIN-DRAMET3.design_boundary: B1.11 evaluates OWLTAB at t1900+dt-1. Serialized advance owns t0/t1, but current drainage-response and full/half temporal-error APIs do not carry the query endpoint. Existing SWBOTB2 canonical-origin/legacy-t1900 mapping is the accepted timing pattern, but the drainage response contract must be extended explicitly.

SW431-DRAIN-ALLOCATION.design_boundary: SWALLO2/3 are sign-direction suppressors inside the native DRAMET3 dispatcher, not generic EXTENDED replacement semantics.

SW431-DRAIN-INF-LIMIT.design_boundary: SWLIMINF channel-depth clipping occurs before INFRES dispatch. EXTENDED cannot replace it because its independent 0.001 cm activation seam has a recorded counterexample.

SW431-DRAIN-DISLAYER.design_boundary: SWDISLAY1 consumes an absolute top. SWDISLAY2 derives a top from groundwater/drain geometry and FTOPDISLAY, then truncates and renormalizes nodal transfer. This is a post-distribution geometry operator, not the existing dmax layer construction.

SW431-DRAIN-DIV-TOPINTERFLOW.design_boundary: B1.11 partitions the highest interflow to its physical drain bottom first, then resets the top of all lower discharge layers. This is distinct from scalar highest-response and SWDISLAY truncation.

SW431-FROST-DIV-MULTI.dependency: QUALIFIED SW431-DRAIN-DIV-MULTI then multilevel frost composition/preservation
SW431-FROST-DIV-MULTI.design_boundary: B19 only admits one signed level; scalar multilevel response is not spatial DIVDRA.

SW431-FROST-EXT-MULTI.design_boundary: Current frost-response validator explicitly restricts extended/highest route to exactly one level, although downstream matrix frost operators are multilevel-shaped.

SW431-FROST-ROOTDRAIN.design_boundary: Current frost-drainage admission intentionally rejects root_extraction_active/root_frost. Removing that guard changes an admitted ownership envelope and requires combined mass/retry/restart qualification.

SW431-FROST-GW.dependency: Bottom-owner composition decision for source-relevant bottom modes
SW431-FROST-GW.design_boundary: Current admitted frost drainage/DIVDRA envelope requires bottom_mode=2. Modes 3/4/5/7/8 have separate accepted owners and cannot be enabled by deleting a validator condition.

SW431-FROST-SNOW.design_boundary: B1.11 snow resistance changes the soil-interface temperature consumed by empirical frost. Current sensible-temperature owner rejects snow and must first acquire the snow-resistance boundary.

qualification_required: O0/O2 compile of signed/multilevel process and serialized runtime
trial reject/retry cleanup and no forcing leakage
restart unchanged because no persistent state was added
claim_ceiling: No census admission is claimed for the two implemented capabilities until the focused and integrated gates complete. All other listed capabilities remain open with a concrete source-bound dependency or design boundary.
